decisions.summary: One table per Japanese era for all ten confirmed ids (osaka-1620 ... edo-1860): each basket good found in its own unit and money with source, goods not found named, the era's day wage beside it; cautions stated

The osaka-1700 recoinage row note gm-assistant endorsed is not stated in any block; it is an unstated detail, not an exclusion (aside).

decisions.summary: Question C: chogin fineness and pure silver a monme by recoinage; koban gold; ryo and bu in silver by market rate (0277's Osaka series named, pre-1787 chronology labeled secondary); nanryo and ichibu-gin; Bassino and Ma's 3.11 g stated with basis SILENT
decisions.why: Q4's monme, ryo and bu in grams of pure silver, market rate where it moved; with D7's per-era coin column this implements gm-assistant's ruling to convert each era at the coinage in circulation (6386690660).

decisions.summary: Mon (and kanmon) in silver handled only by reference: 'The copper rates stay in 0277 (named, not repeated)'; no block gives a mon or kanmon rate a home for the Japanese eras outside 0277's span
decisions.why: Q4 asks 'mon (and kanmon), monme, ryo and bu in Japan by decade', and the request's own canon line says '0277 has Osaka 1787-1859 and Edo 1781-1842'. Against the ten Japanese eras of D2, that leaves osaka-1620, osaka-1700, kyoto-1745 and most of osaka-1780 (before 1781) and edo-1860 (after 1859) with no mon-to-silver rate written anywhere: D3 gives ryo and bu an explicit pre-1787 chronology but gives mon none, D2 prices goods not coins, and D7's per-era 'coins in grams of silver' column has no record source for mon in those eras. Purpose test: the GM's own example amount, the Takamiya-Toriimoto fares of 40/27/20 mon, is re-marked by D5 to osaka-1620 (as are the 1611/1658 post-station fees in mon), and converting a mon amount at osaka-1620 needs exactly the 1620-1650 mon rate this plan does not write; the 1766 1/66 monme and the 1700 legal rate are a single point and a legal rate, where Q4 asks the market rate where it moved. 'Named, not repeated' is a placement rule for rates 0277 holds, not an impossibility for the rates it lacks, and nothing in the request implies excluding them. Fix (one sentence in D3): state where mon/kanmon in silver lives for each Japanese era outside 0277's 1781-1859 span (written into C or 0277, the market rate where it left the legal one) or that it is recorded SILENT with the search named; if 0277 already holds those eras, the block can say so by name and this clears.

decisions.summary: Per Chinese era of the spec's list (beijing-1500 ... beijing-1900) each good in its own money, official prices ATTESTED ONLY FOR official prices, Allen et al. ATTESTED ONLY FOR a modern reconstruction, the era's day wage; Song rice by decade with its row id proposed on #13 once written
decisions.why: Q2/Q3 for China and earlier (Ming, Song 'where it has prices'); the official-price labeling is what gm-assistant confirmed for beijing-1500 and beijing-1736; the Song row follows gm-assistant's confirmation 'with the span you propose once the record writes Song rice'.

decisions.summary: The tael's weight, the dollar, strings and jingqian, cash a tael by point rates per era; a decade series SILENT with its unread sources listed open
decisions.why: Q4 asks copper cash, strings and taels 'in Qing and earlier China' per era; 'by decade' attaches to Japan only, so point rates per era answer it, and the SILENT carries its open sources.

decisions.summary: After id confirmation, each era into money-eras-awaiting.json; record amounts within 25 years of an era marked with it via make money-candidates; 413 backfill lines removed as marked; Takamiya-Toriimoto fares re-marked from kyoto-1745 to osaka-1620; era leaves the awaiting list when gm-assistant's table carries it
decisions.why: FR-003 verbatim plus the thread: amounts inside an era are a subset of the 25-year window, and the window beyond the era implements gm-assistant's borrowed-era requests (Nakasendo fares to the nearest built era 'unless the author judges no era close enough'; Kyoto 1652-56 and the 1611/1658 fees borrowing osaka-1620). The re-mark is what the diagram promised in 6386840957.

decisions.why: FR-004 as written.

decisions.summary: Question A: one table per Japanese era of the confirmed list (ten ids), each good found in the era's own unit and money with source, goods not found named, the day wage beside each era; named cautions stated where the figure stands

decisions.summary: Question C: chogin fineness and pure silver a monme by recoinage; koban gold; ryo and bu in silver by market rate (0277's Osaka series, pre-1787 chronology labeled secondary); nanryo and ichibu-gin silver; Bassino and Ma's 3.11 g with basis SILENT; mon and kanmon in grams of silver for EVERY Japanese era - 0277's market rates converted at the era's chogin where it holds them, elsewhere (osaka-1620, osaka-1700, kyoto-1745 before 1766, osaka-1780 before 1787, edo-1860) the legal rates of 1609 and 1700 plus a market rate where a source read gives one, or SILENT with the search named; osaka-1700's row note names the 1695-1714 recoinages
decisions.why: Round 1's gap is closed: Q4's 'mon (and kanmon), monme, ryo and bu in Japan by decade' now has a figure or a searched SILENT for every Japanese era, with 'the market rate where it moved from the legal one' honored by giving the legal rate and the market rate wherever a source gives one. Converting at the era's own chogin carries gm-assistant's ruling (6386690660); the osaka-1700 recoinage note carries 6386826304. Converting 0277's rates to grams is a new figure citing 0277, consistent with FR-002's 'named, not repeated'.

decisions.summary: Question B: the eight Chinese eras plus Song rice by decade, official prices ATTESTED ONLY FOR official prices, Allen et al.'s Beijing ATTESTED ONLY FOR a modern reconstruction, each with its day wage; Question D: tael weight, dollar, strings and jingqian, cash a tael by point rates, a decade series SILENT with unread sources listed open
decisions.why: Q2/Q3 for China over every confirmed id and the Song row gm-assistant accepted; Q4 asks 'by decade' for Japan only, and for China 'copper cash, strings and taels' - point rates with a searched SILENT on a decade series report what the sources allow.

decisions.summary: Era marks once ids confirmed: each era into money-eras-awaiting.json; record amounts marked where their author judges the era close enough (make money-candidates lists them); 413 backfill lines removed as marked; the 1665 Takamiya-Toriimoto fares re-marked from kyoto-1745 to osaka-1620; eras leave the awaiting list when gm-assistant's table carries them
decisions.why: FR-003 marks every amount whose era this feature defines; 'close enough' governs proximity, and an amount inside an era's years is trivially close, so no in-era amount is excused. The author-judgment test is gm-assistant's own wording on #13 (6386826304: 'unless the author judges no era close enough'); the withdrawn 25-year default is no longer imposed. The 1665 re-mark carries the diagram reply 6386840957 and 6386920252.
